items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Judge' and mentions 'little brother Montgomery' only in response to the interviewer's statement about Judge traveling with him. The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Montgomery.

ctx.x: No, Judge wasn't in that band then. He wasn't in the band with us then. Judge, uh, Judge, uh, he didn't stay in New Orleans that much. He'd mostly be in and out, he'd mostly be here in New York City. He's a good banjo player.
He traveled up to Mississippi for a while, with little brother Montgomery and another group.
Yeah, he didn't stay here much. George was very seldom, I mean, you'd catch him now and the next thing you know he's gone, like Danny Barker, you know. They'd go out and just move abroad.
